description.value: The Naramata General Store is a family-owned community hub in the heart of Naramata village, operating since 1979 and a finalist in Western Living's 2022 Foodies of the Year. It stocks full groceries alongside locally sourced Naramata Bench wines, craft beer, deli sandwiches, house-made soups, and seasonal Okanagan produce — a natural resupply stop for cyclists riding the Naramata Bench wine-country roads. The store also functions as a community notice board and parcel depot, making it a genuine village centre rather than just a convenience shop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms the store is actively operating as a general grocery/deli/bottle shop in Naramata village. Two discrepancies require flagging: OSM lists the name as 'Naramata Store' but the website consistently uses 'Naramata General Store', and OSM lists 225 Robinson Avenue while the website (across multiple subpages including the footer) lists 219 Robinson Avenue — I defer to the website address. Ice is explicitly confirmed ('load the cooler with ice'); basic groceries, deli hot food (soups, sandwiches, Friday tacos), and locally sourced provisions are all confirmed from website text; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Naramata Store' but the business's own website consistently uses 'Naramata General Store' across all pages.
Address mismatch: OSM lists 225 Robinson Avenue; the website footer and contact page consistently list 219 Robinson Avenue. Website address used as primary value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, year-round general store in a small cycling-destination village with confirmed groceries, deli hot food, and ice — directly useful to touring cyclists on the Naramata Bench route.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone (250) 496-5450 and email [email protected] sourced from website; OSM had no phone or email on record.

Hot food.detail: Deli offers house-made soups, hearty sandwiches, and 'Red Neck Taco's every Friday'; mini charcuterie boards also available in the fridge

Ice.detail: Website homepage explicitly mentions 'load the cooler with ice and some local beer & wine'

wow_evidence: finalist in Western Living's 2022 Foodies of the Year...operating since 1979
